summary: Reproduced at 6565dee474d3. A Cleanupper created inside main() with one registered callback was not finalized when main returned, even after gc.collect(): the child printed AFTER_MAIN_GC before CB, so the callback ran only during interpreter exit. weakref.finalize(self, self._shutdown) holds the bound method, which keeps the instance alive.
what_ran: repro.py runs a fresh child Python that imports exllamav3.util.misc.Cleanupper from the worktree, creates one inside main(), registers a print callback, returns, calls gc.collect() and prints a marker, then exits; the parent records the output order.
limits: CPython 3.12 only. The ordering is observed through printed markers, not object identity.
